name: harness-mrtool
description: Deterministic GitLab merge request workflows for Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Create verified GitLab merge requests from repository changes.
interface.longDescription: Uses the harness-mrtool CLI to gather live GitLab context, preview deterministic merge request content, and create, update, or verify managed merge requests.
defaultPrompt: Prepare a deterministic merge request from my changes.
Preview the GitLab merge request for this branch.
Verify the current managed merge request.
